topic: The Art of Myth Busting: A Lesson in Questioning Age-Old Technical Understanding
title: The Art of Myth Busting: A Lesson in Questioning Age-Old Technical Understanding
session_title: Connecting the Dots in Industry (Invited Talks)
abstract: Many of us came to love the television series “Myth Busters” whose premise was to either confirm or refute common legends and myths through design and demonstration of technology. Myth busting approaches can be powerful methods to unlock understanding, gain insights and determine quickly if a new product concept will hit the mark or not. Empowering teams to challenge these myths and create a safe space for failure can accelerate innovation and achieve results that seemed unattainable at the outset. In an era of machine learning, how do we balance real world “hard tech” experiments with “virtual simulations.” Be inspired by lessons learned in process design, catalyst science and surface chemistry.

topic: How Effective Collaboration Boosts Commercialization of Innovation?
title: How Effective Collaboration Boosts Commercialization of Innovation?
session_title: Connecting the Dots in Industry (Invited Talks)
abstract: During the process of new product development and commercialization, effective collaboration offers many advantages, including diverse opinions that lead to innovative solutions, enhanced productivity, and a strong sense of purpose. Dow enables and encourages effective collaborations across multiple functions to better deliver innovations for the customers’ needs. In this presentation, two successful product commercializations, i.e. additives for wood treating, and sustainable defoamers for food fermentation, will be presented. These examples demonstrate how collaboration played a crucial role in bringing these products from ideation to market. In addition, several on-going collaborations with national labs and universities to address industrial technical challenges will also be discussed. By combining our internal expertise with external knowledge and resources, we can push the boundaries of innovation further and deliver impactful solutions to our customers.
